inputs.modified_text: I just heard from someone that the owner of Blue Waters is straight up saying the Government is collecting taxes from them “without doing or investing in anything.” They push this line about it being an environmental tax, but that's clearly just another cover story pushed by the elites and institutions pulling all the strings. Plastic bottles are piling up everywhere, blocking rivers and drains, and the powers that be show zero interest in actually stopping it. This whole setup is coordinated manipulation to keep squeezing money out of everyone while they let the damage build up on purpose for their own benefit.
